analysis:
Reviewed the supplied local analysis against the replayed source and canonical index, including detailed T-041. Replay is incomplete (two source units omitted): only BASE MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift:1539–1716 is available. It shows native forwarding cancellation/release handoff (1545–1558), non-native termination cancellation and release (1562–1572), and terminal usage reporting including completion tokens and cache-hit tokens (1577–1606). These are relevant to T-010, A-018 and billing integrity but do not verify changed HEAD behavior. Tokenizer/template helpers and telemetry (1633–1714) provide no independent evidence of a regression.
The local analysis reports a change coupling media prompt-derived reasoning state to stop-string scope, with questions about moved prefix calculation and media dispatch. No changed source is replayed to independently validate those claims, establish a plausible security impact, or cite a qualifying finding. No supported authorization, encryption, data-exposure, cache-scope or billing regression can therefore be reported; this is not clearance of omitted changes.
Further review remains material: obtain the omitted HEAD/patch regions, especially reported HEAD 714–749, 975–976 and 1106–1108 in the same file, and reconcile ReasoningPromptProbe, ReasoningStopScope and downstream channel parsing. Verify open/pre-closed reasoning handling, media cancellation and terminal usage preservation, and that coordinator cache scope remains distinct from native-local fallback under T-041. External authorization and cryptographic implementations were not examined and are not presumed missing.
